question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**a few.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the given passage is "calcium supplements."
 
• **In blank 3, a quantifier will be used to put emphasis on the amount of grams of calcium supplements that is consumed.**
 
• Among the given options, the correct phrase to use is "a few."
 
 
• **A few means "some (people or things)." It is used to say that there are a small number of people or things.**
 
• In this case, the blank will represent the number of grams of calcium supplement's intake.
 
 
 
• This phrase is grammatically correct to use in the given context. 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Sum" refers to a total amount or the result of adding numbers together.
 
• "Little" means a very small amount or quantity.
 
• Using "few" without the article "a" would refer to a small number without specifying how many.
